Arknights: Endfield is a 3D real-time strategy RPG on PlayStation 5, PC, and mobile. Click the link below to get started today! https://akendfield.gryphline.com/d27t/04m1xuox
Version "Old Deep Water Dies, by Rising Tide It is Denied" is live now. #ArknightsEndfield #Endfield

We loved the original game on Switch - a proper platforming masterclass, running at native 1080p on Tegra X1 with visuals of that quality was no mean feat. Now it has been upgraded for Switch 2, delivering a properly native 4K upgrade, but what about 120Hz? We were hoping ardently for it, but alas, it's not to be.
